title: Charts That Answer Questions
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting charts that answer questions to Excel pivot-table finding with unit labels, source note, and claim-first chart title, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Select a chart type (bar, line, pie, scatter) that matches the question the chart must answer
Apply the zero-baseline rule so bar and column lengths stay proportional, and recognize a truncated value axis as misleading
Write a claim-first chart title that states the finding the chart supports
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
